messages:
jon: flagging weirdness from today's finalize run. a handful of EU customers in cohort pricing-experiment-3 received two finalized invoices for March — one looks correct, the second has VAT applied twice and a different invoice_total.

tara-finance: ugh. any example ids so we can reconcile?

jon: invoice: INV-2024-3317 / cust-eu-453. customer got INV-2024-3317 and INV-2024-3317-dup. totals: 12,480EUR vs 13,728EUR (VAT duplicated on second).

deploy-bot: Release deploy-feature-flags:v61 completed 2469001050 by ci-pipeline (flags: pricing-experiment-3=ON for 5% cohort)

billing-bot: finalize_batch:run_202403_complete status=SUCCESS 2469001100 invoices_finalized=18240 duplicates_detected=27

luca-sre: looking at the renderer logs now. early signal: tax calc path has two hooks, experimental hook gated by feature flag. seems both default tax and experimental hook executed for flagged customers.

jon: here's a minimal reproducer I ran locally:
```
# pseudo
if feature_flags['pricing-experiment-3']:
  apply_vat_new()
apply_vat_base()
```

mira-support: we're seeing ~20 open tickets. some customers already paid the higher amount. need urgent comms + credit flow if overcharged.

finance-head: pause reconciliation payouts for EU_finalized_202403 cohort until we sort. notify legal/compliance.

tara-finance: can we identify how duplicates were created? why invoice ids differ with "-dup" suffix?

jon: renderer emits a suffix when it detects a retry of finalize for the same order_id. race condition: two finalize workers picked same order due to sticky queue misrouting. one worker ran experimental tax path, other ran stable path; both succeeded and were marked final -> emitter appended -dup to the second id.

luca-sre: root cause summary: 1) feature flag enabled experimental VAT path 2) queue sticky routing regression allowed duplicate finalize runs 3) renderer didn't dedupe by canonical_order_id before finalizing pdf.

billing-bot: repair_job queued: dedupe_and_recompute EU_finalized_202403 by jon at 2469001245

jon: plan: 1) rollback flag pricing-experiment-3 immediately 2) patch renderer to dedupe on canonical_order_id + atomic finalize lock 3) run repair job to void duplicate invoices, recompute totals, issue credit notes for overcharges, and trigger customer notifications.

mira-support: draft comms: "We identified duplicate invoices for a subset of EU customers and are issuing credits for any overcharges. Please ignore the extra invoice — the correct amount will be reflected in your account." sending to finance for signoff. :email:

tara-finance: approved. include a short timeline and affected invoice list. finance team will generate credit memos and automated refund flows where payment already captured.

luca-sre: hotfix pushed at 2469001300 to add finalize lock and dedupe check. adding metric: finalize_duplicates_count alert if > 1 for any batch.

billing-bot: repair_job started 2469001325 status=IN_PROGRESS tasks_total=27

jon: sample SQL I used to validate duplicates:
```
SELECT invoice_id, canonical_order_id, total_amount, tax_amount FROM invoices WHERE canonical_order_id='ord-19345' ORDER BY created_at;
-- result: INV-2024-3317, ord-19345, 12480, 1248
--         INV-2024-3317-dup, ord-19345, 13728, 2496
```

mira-support: will triage and tag top-10 impacted customers for priority outreach.

finance-head: after repair, run a full reconciliation for March EU invoices and report variance. schedule a brief postmortem with eng, s-re, support, and finance ops.

jon: adding notes to incident doc and will attach logs + list of duplicate invoice ids after repair job completes.

billing-bot: repair_job completed 2469001370 status=SUCCESS voided_duplicates=27 credits_issued=22 refunds_initiated=3

tara-finance: confirmed credits match ledger. closing loop on this thread. follow-ups: feature flag rollout checklist update, finalize-lock metrics, customer outreach postmortem.

jon: thanks all. leaving the postmortem doc link in #finance-docs once written. :thumbsup:
